Take nothing else. There is nothing else. Whatever does the giving here has given what it had.
The rest of the road is yours to be unkind to.

quests.name: What Is Left of the Light
quests.summary: Something bright is lodged under your breastbone, and it is trying to find the rest of itself.

stages.summary: Maren Wick keeps the beacon at First Light. She will not light it herself.

objectives.text: Light the beacon at First Light

stages.summary: There is a Warden on the verge road who has not been told the road is over.

objectives.text: Light the beacon at the Leaning Gate

stages.summary: The fen keeps books. Whoever is keeping them has been at it two hundred years.
A note held so long it has stopped being music. The Pale Choir is still holding it.
The first fire is still lit. The man who was told to keep it is still keeping it.
There is a crown in the Palewaste being held by a man who will not put it down or on.
The Frostmarch is one long held breath. Something up there is holding it.
The last shard did not belong to anyone here. It came in through the hole.
Everything you carry leans the same way now. Follow it to the far corner of everything.

objectives.text: Light the beacon in the Hollow

stages.summary: The last unbroken piece is still trying to do the only thing it ever did.
The Gatewarden is still at the gate. He has been waiting to see what you do with it.
Three ends. Reforge it, scatter it, or keep it. Nobody will thank you for any of them.

objectives.text: Decide what the light is for

onComplete.text: It is done, in the way things are done here.

quests.name: First Steps on the Verge
quests.summary: A short road from waking to your first shard. Follow the markers.

stages.summary: Maren Wick is at the beacon just ahead. Talk to her, then light it. Beacons heal you and become your respawn point, but resting there brings enemies back.

objectives.text: Light the beacon at First Light

onEnter.text: Tip: follow the faint arrow near your character. It points to your objective.

stages.summary: Old Orrin Stave keeps a post south-west of the beacon. He knows the road and the thing on it.

objectives.text: Find Orrin Stave at the Warden's Post

onEnter.text: Tip: tap ATK for quick swings, hold it to charge a heavy. Dodge through attacks.

stages.summary: The Leaning Gate beacon stands on the road north, before the Warden. Light it so a death does not send you all the way back.

objectives.text: Light the beacon at the Leaning Gate

onEnter.text: Tip: crates, barrels and cracked walls break. Some hide souls.

stages.summary: The Ashen Warden is still keeping a road that ended. Put him down and take your first shard.

onEnter.text: Tip: if you die, your souls stay where you fell. Go back and touch the stain to recover them.

quests.name: Notice of Relief
quests.summary: Orrin Stave was relieved of the road forty years ago. The paperwork never reached him.

stages.summary: Orrin wants the order in his hand. He will not take your word for it.
The order was countersigned by the Warden on the road. He is still on the road.

objectives.text: Take the countersignature from the Ashen Warden

stages.summary: Bring it back to the post and let him read it.

quests.name: The Lamp-Wife's Measure
quests.summary: Maren keeps a lamp she has never lit. She would like to know it still could be.

stages.summary: Wornstone, five pieces, ground fine. She is particular about the grade.
She wants a beacon lit in a place she will not walk to.

quests.name: Gilly Counts the Trees
quests.summary: There were four hundred and six. Something has been reducing the number.

stages.summary: The hounds come down the mill track at dusk and take the young wood.
Gilly says there is a tree that should not be counted. She wants you to see it.

quests.name: Tabb's Arrangement
quests.summary: Tabb salvages. He would like a share of what the Hollowwood has stopped needing.

stages.summary: Grave offerings. Three. He does not ask where from and you should not tell him.
He wants the mill track cleared of the brigands who have been undercutting him.

quests.name: Kept Iron
quests.summary: Halvard will not work new iron. He says new iron has not agreed to anything yet.

stages.summary: Four pieces of kept iron, off things that were used until they broke.
He needs a fire hot enough, and the wayside forge has been cold since the ash.

objectives.text: Come back and stand where the heat is

quests.name: What the Strand Kept
quests.summary: Ismay wrecks ships that stopped sailing a century ago. She is not embarrassed about it.

stages.summary: The husks came in with the tide and will not go out with it.
She wants the keel lit so she can see what she is standing in.

quests.name: Bell Came Back Wet
quests.summary: She drowned at the Salt Pilings and then did not stay drowned. She would like to know why.

stages.summary: She remembers the stair and nothing between the stair and the pilings.

objectives.text: Walk the Tide Stair for her

stages.summary: Quietwater, two draughts. She says the salt is still in the remembering.

objectives.text: Sit with Bell while it works

quests.name: Reading the Tide
quests.summary: Carrow reads the tide and does not like what it has begun to say.

stages.summary: Two lights on the strand and he can triangulate what the water is doing.
The reading is bad. He wants the leeches off the shallows before he explains it.

quests.name: One in Ten
quests.summary: Alder Nine still collects the tithe. He is very clear that he did not invent it.

stages.summary: Nine offerings out of the fen, and the tenth he takes himself.
The books are behind. He would like the crawlers out of the ledger house first.

quests.name: The One That Was Left
quests.summary: The Ninth was the ninth of ten and was not taken. She has been trying to correct that.

stages.summary: She wants to see the Notch counted properly, once, with a light on it.
And then she wants the counting stopped at the source.

objectives.text: Tell the Ninth it is over

quests.name: Wren's Short List
quests.summary: Wren Stilt has a list of everyone the village lost. She keeps adding to it.

stages.summary: The blightborn come up under the stilts and she cannot keep the boards down.
There is a place under the causeway she has never had the nerve to look at.

objectives.text: Bring Wren rotwort for the fever
Tell Wren what is under there

quests.name: The Cold Forge
quests.summary: Cald Ferrin's forge went out during the ash and he has been not-relighting it ever since.

stages.summary: Named ash, twice. Ash off something that had a name when it burned.
He needs the Cold Forge lit by someone who is not him.

quests.name: Milestone Nine
quests.summary: Peth Ivory guards a stone that says how far it is to somewhere that is not there.

stages.summary: She will not leave the stone. She would like to know what is at the tenth.

objectives.text: Walk to where the tenth milestone should be

stages.summary: Hollowed knights are walking the reach between the stones, still in order.

objectives.text: Stop the count at the ring of stones

quests.name: The Kiln Road
quests.summary: Odry Vaunt is walking to a shrine that burned down before she was born.

stages.summary: She will not walk it alone in the dark, and there is a lot of dark on the kiln road.
Cinder resin for the last of the walk. Three sticks. She counts them out loud.

objectives.text: Walk the last of it with her

quests.name: The Seedbed
quests.summary: Nesh Barrow plants what comes up out of the Bone Orchard. Something else has been planting too.

stages.summary: The blightborn are getting into the beds and coming up wrong.
Four offerings from the older ground, to put back what was taken out.

objectives.text: Close the mouth the long pit grew

quests.name: What the Well Draws
quests.summary: Sibyl Kell treats the hollowing. She is honest that treating is not curing.

stages.summary: Bloodmoss, four wads, off the wet side of the orchard.
The revenants around the Marrow Well have started coming when she draws water.

quests.name: The Watch at the Rib Arch
quests.summary: Cassock Vane has stood under the Rib Arch since it was a doorway to something.

stages.summary: The wraiths come through the arch at the same hour. He would like that stopped.
He wants a light under the arch, which is the one order he was never given.

objectives.text: Stand the watch with him once

quests.name: The Drowned Barracks
quests.summary: Serjeant Ruell still holds a muster for a garrison that is under four feet of water.

stages.summary: He wants the barracks lit before he will call the roll in front of you.
Half the roll answers. The half that answers is not friendly.

objectives.text: Put down the ones that answered
Let the last dry room out

quests.name: The Low Bell
quests.summary: Onnet Slack rings a bell nobody comes to. He is not ready to stop.

stages.summary: The clapper cracked. He needs oathglass, twice, and will not say why that and nothing else.
He wants it rung once with the beacon lit, so someone somewhere sees and hears together.

quests.name: Puck's Catch
quests.summary: Puck Hollis fishes the Reed Gate. He is not fishing for fish, and he knows you have noticed.

stages.summary: The leeches are stripping his lines before the lines get anywhere.
He asks you to look the other way for one hour. It is your choice whether you do.

quests.name: The Seventh Voice
quests.summary: Vantine Aske was the choirmistress. She has not sung since they started holding the note.

stages.summary: She wants the forecourt lit, so the nave can be approached the proper way.
And then she wants the note let go, which nobody living has the standing to do but you.

quests.name: Grieve's Last Mould
quests.summary: Grieve Tull has one mould left and no reason to fill it. Give him one.

stages.summary: Named ash, three measures, off things that burned with names on them.
The yard is full of choirblades who object to the sound of a hammer.

quests.name: Who Holds the Seventh
quests.summary: Sem was given the seventh note to hold. He was seven. Nobody has come to take it back.

stages.summary: He will not leave the alcove until someone lights it, because that is the signal he was told to wait for.
He asks you to hold it instead. Say something, either way.

quests.name: The Tender's Argument
quests.summary: Ondrey Sparr has been arguing with a dead man about whether a fire is still needed.

stages.summary: The other tenders take the side of the fire. Loudly.
The Knight will not hear it from a tender. He might hear it from something carrying shards.

quests.name: The Obsidian Step
quests.summary: Yrsa Lound walks a stair of black glass and counts what she sees at the bottom.

stages.summary: The emberhounds run the step in packs and she is one archer.
She wants the bottom of the step reached by somebody, once, so it can stop being a question.

objectives.text: Reach the bottom of the step
Tell Yrsa what is down there

quests.name: The Kneeling Stone
quests.summary: Anselm Vay has been kneeling for a while and cannot remember what for.

stages.summary: Six offerings, one for each thing he thinks it might have been.
He will only stand up if the stone is lit and something worse is dealt with first.

quests.name: The Empty Court
quests.summary: Ossia Fenn announces a king to an empty room, at the correct hour, every day.

stages.summary: She wants the court lit so the announcement is made properly, whatever else is wrong with it.
The King is standing in the white obelisk field with the crown in his hand.

quests.name: The Nine Cairns
quests.summary: Halda Rime counts nine cairns every morning. Lately she gets ten, and then nine again.

stages.summary: She wants the cairns lit and counted with a witness who is not her.
The tenth cairn is being kept by something enormous that has not moved in two hundred years.

quests.name: Anchorage Iron
quests.summary: Torv Nendel makes anchors for a harbour that has been frozen since before his father.

stages.summary: A remembered ember, twice, and he can get the anchorage forge to take.
The wraiths off the ice come in when the forge is hot. They always have.

quests.name: Sideways, and Back
quests.summary: Ilex Vore went through the door and came back with most of herself.

stages.summary: She wants the door lit and looked at from this side by someone who will report honestly.
The thing that came through is still on this side of it.

quests.name: The Last Obelisk
quests.summary: Quen Ardith is the last obelisk. She would prefer not to be the last of anything.

stages.summary: The obelisks were a chain. She wants one more link lit before she goes out.
The riftborn have been walking the chain and putting it out behind you.

objectives.text: Break the riftborn on the chain
Sit with Quen while it holds

quests.name: The One Before You
quests.summary: The Gatewarden was Vesselborn once. He got as far as the gate and stopped.

stages.summary: He will not talk about it until the gate is lit, and he will not light it.
He asks what you intend. He has heard all three answers before and buried the people who gave them.

objectives.text: Tell the Gatewarden what you intend

quests.name: The First Dark
quests.summary: Wick remembers the moment the light went out. She is the only thing that does.

stages.summary: She cannot say it while it is dark where she is standing.
And then she needs to be shown a shard, close, so she can be certain it is the same light.

quests.name: The Tenth in Ten
quests.summary: Nine were counted. Nobody has ever asked what happened to the tenth.

stages.summary: Ten offerings out of the fen, taken without asking anyone's leave.
Take them to the Black Pool, where the count was originally made.

quests.name: Where It Fell
quests.summary: Everything you carry has begun to lean the same way. Follow it all the way down.

stages.summary: The lean gets worse the further in you go. That is the only direction there is.
There is a shape of absence exactly the size of the thing that used to be there.

quests.name: A Lantern, Taken
quests.summary: Somebody has been putting out beacons behind you and taking the light away in a jar.

stages.summary: The Broken Lantern goes out roughly an hour after anyone lights it.
Whoever takes it is still nearby, and has stopped bothering to hide.

quests.name: Word for Word
quests.summary: Carrow has read the strand’s future and it lands on Ismay first. He reads; he does not deliver.

stages.summary: Carry the reading up the strand to the wrecker, word for word.
Tell Carrow what she did with it. He will want the wording of that too.

quests.name: Received at Court
quests.summary: A dissolved garrison is dismissed where it stood and received where it was ordered. Ruell’s roll has never arrived.

stages.summary: Carry the muster roll south to the herald of the Empty Court.

objectives.text: Give the roll to Ossia Fenn

stages.summary: Tell the serjeant his garrison has arrived.

quests.name: The Tenth Anchor
quests.summary: Nine cairns for nine parties that went up. Torv has forged something for the one that stayed.

stages.summary: Carry the anchor to the Nine Cairns and set it with Halda.

objectives.text: Set the anchor at the cairns

stages.summary: Tell Torv the count came out even.

quests.name: The Unlit Lamp
quests.summary: A house lamp with one burn left in it, and an instruction: not for the road. For after the road.

stages.summary: Carry Maren’s lamp to the Vessel Gate. Do not light it on the way.

objectives.text: Bring the lamp to the far corner of everything

stages.summary: There were always three words at the gate. Bring a fourth.

quests.name: The Ways Out
quests.summary: Three ends, says everyone who has never stood at the gate. The gate itself is less certain of the number.

stages.summary: The Gatewarden has laid out the ends. Which of them will open for you is written in how you have played.

objectives.text: Decide what the light is for
Scatter — learn from Wick how it broke
Take — make room: feed the slag, or keep what you take
A fourth word — a lamp, a jar, and the truth of the breaking

stages.summary: It is chosen, in the way things are chosen here.

objectives.text: Say the word and mean it

quests.name: The Chronicle
quests.summary: What is happening to this kingdom writes itself into you a page at a time. The lamp-wife suggests you keep count.

stages.summary: The road west, and what the shards make of the people who hold them.

objectives.text: Light the beacon at First Light

stages.summary: The far half of the kingdom, and the far corner of everything.

objectives.text: Decide what the light is for
What Is Left of the Light

lines: There was one light.
It was not a god. It made no demands.
It lit things, and things that are lit grow.
Then it broke.
Nobody agrees on the hour. Every clock in the kingdom stopped at a different one.
It came apart over this kingdom the way a lamp comes apart on a floor.
The pieces went into whoever was standing nearest.
Wardens. Kings. A woman who kept books.
You wake on the verge road.
A splinter of something bright under the breastbone.
No memory of agreeing to it.
This is normal. Nobody has ever agreed to it.
The rite requires a child, a promise, and a ninth step.
Everyone who has read it has scratched the ninth step through.
You are what is left when it is performed anyway.
Seven of them are still awake. They felt you open your eyes.
Walk west. The lamp-wife is waiting.
The beacon takes your shard's measure.
It lights, badly, for the first time in a century.
A hundred years waiting to be told what it is by something that knew.
Now it knows.
It can tell the next one along, and the next —
if you can get there.
The King never sat.
Sitting is agreement, and he would not agree to a kingdom in this condition.
Five shards now, and they do not sit quietly together.
Each remembers being part of one thing.
Each is trying, in its small stubborn way, to reassemble the rest inside you.
You are not gathering trophies.
You are a table on which something is putting itself back together.
The abdication was written, witnessed and sealed.
It was never delivered.
There is no one left with standing to receive a crown.
Except, possibly, whatever you are becoming.

cutscenes.name: What Is Left of the Light

lines: It is not a crater.
It is a hollow — a shape of absence the exact size of what used to be there.
It was never a god. It lit things, and things that are lit grow.
Then it broke. Without malice. Without warning.
This is the last unbroken piece.
Still doing the only thing it ever did.
It cannot understand why the world keeps flinching.
You put the shards back.
You are the lamp, and the oil, and the room it is in.
It is not gentle. It was never going to be gentle.
The eleven days of screaming were the honest version.
The light returns whole.
And with it everything it ever lit.
The Warden's road. The tally. The seventh note. The standing King.
All of it, restored exactly as it was.
Including the flaw that broke it.
Somewhere, a child is being measured for a rite.
The dawn is genuinely beautiful.
It will hold for a while.
You open your hands and let it go.
All of it. In every direction. Too fine ever to gather again.
The husks lie down. The bells stop.
The Warden's road is just a road, going nowhere, honestly.
It is the first honest dark in two centuries.
Nothing in it grows. Nothing in it is held against its will.
Four generations, gently, without a single scream in it.
Nobody will thank you.
There will, quite soon, be nobody to.
You keep it. All seven, and the eighth.
The room you had for them turns out to have been the point.
The light is yours now, and it is not the same light.
It has opinions. And a face. And a memory of walking.
You will be very good at this.
You will be very good at this for a long time.
And then, exactly like the last one, you will break.
Someone will wake on a verge road.
A splinter of you under the breastbone.
No memory of agreeing.
A house lamp. One wick. One burn. One room's worth of light.
I have counted every light in this kingdom twice, and never counted that one.
I am standing very still. That is a hundred years of arithmetic, coming out.
Seven instructions. The last unbroken piece.
A jar of stolen beacon-light, and a century of careful dark.
Poured steadily, the way you fill a lamp in a house where someone is sleeping.
It takes.
It lights a table, not a kingdom.
Nothing grows by it except whatever chooses to sit down.
Somewhere north, a woman feels her mother's room get warmer, and does not ask.
It has one good burn in it. So, between us, do you.
A stall where there was no stall.
"Doors open now, friend. They always do, after."
"Come back when you are ready to finish a legend."
Far to the east, over the sea, a shrine gate stands in falling petals.
Someone there felt a light go out, and then come back different.
A sword is drawn. Then another. Then many.

dlc.name: The Unfinished Legend
dlc.description: The Sealed Vaults beneath the beacons open. Three weapons and the Vaultwarden's armour, carried by those who tried to finish the Bright Spirit's story before you.

weapons.name: Lastlight, the Unfinished Oath
weapons.description: Its last verse was never engraved. The smith left the space blank, and the blade has been waiting to learn the words ever since.

weapons.name: Vaultwarden's Verdict
weapons.description: Kept behind the third seal, for the one who would come asking what the vaults were guarding. It did not say whether to let them in.

weapons.name: Sealbreaker Bow
weapons.description: Strung with wire drawn from a vault lock. Every arrow it looses remembers being a key.

armour.name: Vaultwarden's Visor
armour.description: Slits cut for eyes that had to watch a door for a hundred years.

armour.name: Vaultwarden's Hauberk
armour.description: Every ring is stamped with the same seal. None of them is the one that opens.

armour.name: Vaultwarden's Keygloves
armour.description: Worn smooth at the fingertips from turning locks that never turned back.

armour.name: Vaultwarden's Greaves
armour.description: Heavy enough to stand on a seal while it shakes.

armourSets.name: Vaultwarden's Charge
armourSets.description: The armour of those who kept the Sealed Vaults after the light went out.

bonuses.text: The Road Law is yours to speak.
